name: Cocona Stemper
source:
Occupation: Selling lemomade
Hobbies: Gardening
Skills: Cooking
Likes: Her younger siblings
Dislikes: Bugs (especially caterpillars)

A kind and friendly girl who sells lemonade in the street corner because her family is poor. Her parents often beat Kokona and her siblings, with whom she lives together nowadays. Because of the constant abuse, she has a scar on her back. She entered the Closed GAME out of her own will because she has always dreamt of living in a better place together with her younger siblings.
